title: Not organic catnip, so cats didn’t like the toys.
text: The toys are cute, all Halloween themed, but neither of my cats would play with any of them. Some were packed full of catnip that smelled quite a bit different to them, and to me, than the organic catnip I usually give them. They both scrunched up their noses/faces when sniffing the toys, then would have nothing to do with them. The box was a hit once everything was removed though, but unless the company switch over to all organic catnip in the toys, I won’t be buying another box. I should add that all the toys were made in China. My cats also usually love getting new toys, so their complete disinterest in any of the toys in this box was odd. Before I opened the box, both were excited as a toy jingled when I shook the box.  That excitement quickly died as they smelled the toys. Very strange!
label: negative
